Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by the 1050m, Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved a length or So in Straight while dropping back to finish last # never featured
Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 7.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # never a factor
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd last 9 Lengths 600m 7th 8 Lengths home turn 3 Wide 7th Middle Of Track widest runner Straight weakened final 200m # average/weak late

Jumped okay & Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 8.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked widest Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # never a factor

Jumped okay & Settled Down 7 Lengths Four Wide , worked uip and in 3 Wide by the 1100m, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover but Under Pressure turning, Held Ground in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.] # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, taken straight back & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths on fence, railed to 6 Lengths turning, followed eventual winner through and into the rails run and kept pace with it down the Straight # battled on ok

Away well. Eased to race @ rear on inside (5L from lead) early . Improved 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken @ 550m. Pushed to quicken 3 Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 200m & sprinted to challenge leaders @ 100m. Fought on in 2-horse battle in last 100m & did best late. # Sprinted from rear
